entry.summary:

entry.title: Land use & zoning · Mon, Aug 17, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Washington Park Master Plan Approval and Adoption. City Council voted 6-0 to adopt an ordinance approving and adopting the Washington Park Master Plan. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Discussion / report: Staff Follow-Up on Southeast Zoning Inquiry. The Community Engagement Manager reported that following a resident inquiry regarding the application of the zoning code to property in Southeast Roanoke, staff from Planning, Building, and Development met with the resident on August 11.

entry.title: Land use & zoning · Mon, Sep 21, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Rezoning Request for Parcels at 2717, 2719, and 0 Colonial Avenue SW. City Council held a public hearing and adopted an ordinance granting the request of LD Cyrus Builders Inc. to rezone 2717, 2719, and three parcels at 0 Colonial Avenue SW from MX and R-7 to RMF with conditions and CN with conditions. Council Member Hagen was not present when the 6-0 vote was recorded. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6565,plainText=false)

entry.title: Land use & zoning · Mon, Oct 19, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Rezoning of 0 Janette Avenue SW. Following a public hearing, City Council voted 7-0 to adopt Ordinance No. 43486-101926, rezoning 0 Janette Avenue SW from Recreation and Open Space District (ROS) to Residential District (RM-2). Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Rezoning of Parcels at 0 Franklin Road SW. Following a public hearing, City Council voted 7-0 to adopt Ordinance No. 43487-101926, approving the request of Lawson Company Incorporated to rezone three parcels at 0 Franklin Road SW from Mixed Use District (MX) to Residential District (RM-2). Recorded vote: 7-0.
Withdrawn: Proffer Repeal Request for 3509 Peters Creek Road NW. A public hearing request by Echo Sentinel Group, LLC, to repeal all conditions proffered in a previous rezoning at 3509 Peters Creek Road NW was withdrawn.
Adopted: Enterprise Zone One A Boundary Amendments. Following a public hearing, City Council voted 7-0 to adopt Resolution No. 43488-101926, approving boundary amendments to Enterprise Zone One A. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6588,plainText=false)
